about: ModGate's default policy. Pass -Policy=<path> to use your own copy and -Profile=<name> to pick a profile. Rule IDs: M1 Blueprint script, M2 dangerous engine function, M3 native code, M4 script or shell file, M5 command text, M6 config file, M7 file type not allowed, M8 not inspectable (always block), M9 unnamed native reference, M10 shader code, M11 game classes used. Severities: block, warn, info, off.

data-only.about: Mods carry data only. Any Blueprint script is blocked, because compiled Blueprints can't be sandboxed.

blueprint-mods.about: Harm reduction for games that already accept Blueprint mods. Blueprint script is a warning; calls to known-dangerous functions are still blocked. A crafted Blueprint can still escape: the interpreter does no type checks.

riskyFunctions.why: Opens any URL through the operating system shell. Unless Engine.ini restricts it, file:// and other schemes run programs. Meccha Chameleon's Workshop malware ran its batch file this way.
